Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Male  [OR] or female
  -  Aged 18-40 years
  -  Willing and able to give informed consent for participation in the study
  -  Sufficiently fluent English to understand and complete the task
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Current usage of psychoactive medication (except the contraceptive pill, the Depo-Provera  [OR] injection or the progesterone implant)
  -  Any past  [OR] or current Axis 1 DSM-IV psychiatric disorder
  -  Significant medical condition
  -  Current  [OR] or past gastro-intestinal disorder  [OR] or irritable bowel syndrome
  -  Current pregnancy  [OR] or breastfeeding
  -  Known lactate deficiency  [OR] or any other problem absorbing lactose, [OR]  galactose  [OR] or glucose
  -  Current  [OR] or past history of drug  [OR] or alcohol dependency
  -  Participation in a psychological  [OR] or medical study involving the use of medication within the last 3 months
  -  Previous participation in a study using the same, [OR]  or similar, emotional processing tasks
  -  Smoker > 5 cigarettes per day
  -  Typically drinks > 6 caffeinated drinks per day
